criteria: On a real macOS display under Cocoa/QMacStyle, the exact bound executable renders the unchanged accepted Dif with readable, clean alpha edges in System, Light, Dark, high-contrast Light and high-contrast Dark appearance at ordinary, compact and expanded window sizes.

candidates.title: Dif native Full and Reduced motion
criteria: On a focused real macOS window under Cocoa/QMacStyle, app Motion Full shows a restrained greeting followed by calm breathing and blink at actual speed, while app Motion Reduced remains on a static rest frame without queued playback or a repeated greeting when returning to Full.
candidates.content: Verify the executable digest and launch the isolated fixture app. On Home, set Motion to Full and observe greeting, calm breathing and a blink at actual speed. Set Motion to Reduced and observe a static interval. Return to Full and confirm calm resumes without a queued cue or repeated greeting. Accept only if this motion criterion was observed; otherwise reject and name the failing transition. Close the app normally.

candidates.title: Dif macOS Reduce Motion observation
criteria: With app Motion set to System and the owner window focused, changing macOS Accessibility > Display > Reduce Motion from its original value and back changes Dif between Full playback and static Reduced rest without a queued cue or repeated greeting, and the original operating-system value is restored before finishing.
candidates.content: Verify the executable digest and launch the isolated fixture app. Set app Motion to System. Record the original macOS Accessibility > Display > Reduce Motion value, change it to the opposite value while the app window is focused, and confirm Dif follows. Change it back and confirm Dif follows without a queued cue or repeated greeting. Restore the original operating-system value before answering. Accept only if the entire system-observer criterion was observed; otherwise reject and name the failed direction or behavior. Close the app normally.
